clarifications: The counts sentence excludes only the candidate_limit overflow file. A total_bytes_limit candidate is counted as considered, as already fixed in addendum v1.

Regular-file/type and per-file size admission precede the remaining total-byte allowance. A report larger than 16MiB produces report_bytes_limit and scanning continues, even when its size also exceeds remaining total bytes. Only an otherwise per-file-size-admissible candidate can terminate scanning with total_bytes_limit.
